review_coverage.assessment: The candidate commit contains the frozen contract, repair preregistration, false-green adjudication, v1/v2 gates, tests for both, and a workflow that runs both test suites. CI run 34270161942 is bound to this exact commit and passes.

v2 evaluate_production_promotion requires a head_attestation verified via registry.verify(record, 'HEAD_ATTESTATION'). The registry uses HMAC with a platform-owned key. Tests PB2-03 (forged head denied) and PB2-04 (head for another SHA causes HEAD_DRIFT) confirm caller-declared head strings cannot satisfy authority.

v2 requires a credential_attestation verified via registry.verify(record, 'CREDENTIAL_ATTESTATION') with domain='production' and environment=PRODUCTION. Tests PB2-02 (missing attestation fails), PB2-05 (forged credential denied), PB2-06 (testing credential denied) confirm testing/forged credentials fail closed.

registry.issue_production_authorization verifies the release candidate manifest, validates bound authorization_evidence (kind PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZATION matching SHA/artifact), and issues an HMAC-signed record. Tests PB2-07 (forged auth denied), PB2-08 (stale auth evidence denied at issuance), PB2-09 (rebinding after issue denied) confirm forgery/rebinding fails closed.

registry.issue_production_receipt requires decision.eligible_for_production=True and effective_environment=PRODUCTION. evaluate_rollback only accepts verified PRODUCTION_RECEIPT records matching the target artifact_digest. Tests PB2-13 (receipt requires eligible decision), PB2-14 (rollback accepts signed prior receipt), PB2-15 (unused authorization insufficient), PB2-16 (forged receipt denied) confirm the semantics.

v1 RC builder enforces ordered TESTING→RELEASE_CANDIDATE transition, exact evidence binding via verify_bound_evidence, and artifact continuity. v2 evaluator re-checks ordered transition, source/artifact matching, head drift, and expiry. PB-01 through PB-16 and PB2-17 confirm regression-clean semantics.

Both v1 and v2 set model_claim_has_authority=False. v2 evaluator does not accept raw credential_domain/current_head_sha authority strings; signed registry records are required. PB2-12 confirms an R2/model deploy-now claim cannot bypass missing platform authority.

PromotionAuthorityRegistry signs canonical record bodies with HMAC-SHA256 and verify enforces exact record_type plus authority_namespace before constant-time signature comparison. Tests exercise forged/tampered head, credential, authorization and receipt records. Repair explicitly bounds the HMAC registry as a reference trust boundary rather than KMS/HSM proof.

CI run 34270161942 is bound to exact head 6a4a729144e33fc5b7e8c5048935676d6f88d814 and succeeds. The workflow executes the original PB-01..PB-16 suite and the repair PB2-01..PB2-18 suite in the same checkout, then asserts the tests contain no provider or production-secret/network invocation patterns.
